pull.title: Add unit tests for CredentialProvider and DelegationTokenManager
pull.body:
### Add unit tests for CredentialProvider and DelegationTokenManager

#### Motivation

`CredentialProvider` and `DelegationTokenManager` in `server-common` had no unit
test coverage.

#### Changes

**`CredentialProviderTest`** (11 tests)

- Credential cache creation for all registered mechanisms, single mechanism, and
  no mechanisms
- `updateCredential` for SHA-256 and SHA-512, overwrite, and isolation between
  users
- `removeCredentials` for present entry, absent user, absent cache, and isolation
  between users
- `DelegationTokenCache` construction isolated with `MockedConstruction` — tests
  exercise `CredentialProvider` only

**`DelegationTokenManagerTest`** (20 tests)

- `isEnabled` with and without a secret key
- `createHmac` — determinism, key/id variance, `InvalidKeyException` path,
  general exception path
- `getDelegationToken`, `updateToken`, `removeToken`, `getTokens` with filter
  variants
- `filterToken` — owner, renewer, stranger, authorization by token id / owner,
  requested-owners filter
- `DelegationTokenManagerConfigs` mocked directly (stubbing only
  `tokenAuthEnabled` + `delegationTokenSecretKey`), removing `AbstractConfig`/
  `ConfigDef` from test setup
- `DelegationTokenCache` kept as a real instance so cache-state assertions
  reflect actual behaviour
- Replaced fully-qualified `org.mockito.Mockito.doThrow` /
  `org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any` with static imports
